terms.gloss: at ground level, entered without steps
evidence: Vitruvius 6.8.1: aedificia quae plānō pede īnstituuntur (Lewis & Short cites the older numbering 6.11)
Vitruvius 7.4.1: conclāvibus, quae plānō pede fuerint

phrases.latin: Hīc plānō pede intrāmus; illīc dēscendimus in hypogēum.
phrases.english: Here we walk straight in; over there we go down to the basement.
